response.justification: While Bogdan is an experienced and accomplished software engineer with 20+ years in the field, he is a poor fit for this C++-focused industrial automation role. His C++ experience is minimal and dated (2014-2015), his career has centered on web and full-stack development, and he lacks any demonstrated expertise in secure development practices, industrial cybersecurity standards (IEC 62443), embedded systems, IoT, or industrial automation domains. The role requires deep, current C++ expertise with manufacturing systems knowledge; his profile shows divergent trajectory toward Node.js and AI agents.
strengths: Extensive 20+ years of software development experience with proven ability to architect systems across multiple domains and technologies
Strong leadership and mentoring background as Staff Engineer and founder, with demonstrated commitment to software craftsmanship and knowledge sharing
Deep expertise in modern development practices including TDD, CI/CD pipelines, and agile methodologies
concerns: C++ experience is severely limited and 11-12 years outdated; current focus and recent roles center on TypeScript, Node.js, and full-stack web development
No background in industrial automation, embedded systems, IoT, or real-time systems; lacks domain knowledge for manufacturing and on-premises solutions
Zero demonstrated experience with secure development practices, IEC 62443 standards, MQTT, multi-threading, or message-broker architectures required for the role

key_factors.factor: No industrial automation or cybersecurity domain background
Strong general software engineering fundamentals and leadership experience
